---
title: "tar"
---

Create a tarball without compression. (GNU tar 1.35)

```bash
tar -cf archive.tar path/to/files
```

Create a highly compressed tarball with Zstandard; GeoTIFFs may already be internally compressed, so size reduction can be modest. (GNU tar 1.35; Zstandard 1.5.5)

```bash
tar -I 'zstd -19' -cf archive.tar.zst path/to/files
```
